headline: Canva cuts 1,271 jobs in global workforce restructuring
summary: Graphic design platform Canva is restructuring its global workforce, affecting 1,271 employees or 22% of its staff, to simplify operations and centralise teams.
why: Workforce reductions by large technology companies reflect efforts to streamline operational costs and realign resources.
